title: EMNLP: Educator-role Moral and Normative Large Language Models Profiling

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model decision-making on 88 teacher-specific moral dilemmas mapped to Kohlberg's stages of moral development, and assessing vulnerability to generating harmful/unethical content using targeted soft prompt injections.

Comparing LLMs' self-reported traits on psychometric scales (HEXACO-60 and CPST-E) against a benchmark of 100 human in-service teachers to identify idealized, polarized, or emotionally constrained behaviors in simulated professional roles.
Conducting cross-lingual evaluations of moral dilemmas in both English and Chinese to measure how the linguistic and cultural contexts embedded in model training data impact moral reasoning stages.
